# Runtime app requirements are pinned to known-good versions for Railway.
# Floating upgrades caused builder disk blowups and unstable redeploys.

# Core web framework
fastapi==0.122.0
uvicorn==0.38.0
starlette>=0.41.0  # imported directly by mapmover code (research_corpus, chat_shared);
                   # currently installed transitively by fastapi==0.122.0 but pinned
                   # here defensively after the 2026-05-31 transitive-import audit
                   # to prevent silent removal on a future requirements pin pass.

# Environment and configuration
python-dotenv==1.2.2

# LLM integration
anthropic==0.75.0

# HTTP requests
requests==2.32.5
boto3==1.42.0
# NOTE: do NOT add an explicit botocore pin. The 2026-05-31 transitive-import audit
# flagged botocore as imported but undeclared in code (mapmover/research_corpus.py,
# mapmover/routes/chat_shared.py). However boto3 1.42.0 strict-pins botocore to
# `<1.42.0,>=1.41.6`, so any independent botocore pin conflicts with the boto3 pin
# and breaks the Railway build (verified the hard way 2026-05-31). botocore can't
# silently drop while boto3 is pinned, so the audit concern doesn't apply here.
httpx==0.27.2  # used by mapmover/auth_context.py for async Supabase auth verification;
               # was previously installed as a transitive dep of unpinned anthropic/supabase
               # but dropped after 2026-05-20 requirements pin, breaking the commercial-access
               # verifier path and triggering 502s on /api/v1/query/dataset (the 2026-05-19
               # 402index.io regression).

# Data processing
pandas==2.3.3
numpy==2.3.5
duckdb==1.5.0
# CVE-2026-25087 is not reachable through this Python/Parquet runtime, but
# 23.0.1 includes the upstream Arrow IPC memory-safety fix.
pyarrow==23.0.1
orjson==3.11.4  # Fast JSON parsing (3-10x faster than stdlib)
msgpack==1.1.2  # MessagePack serialization (2-5x faster, 30-50% smaller)

# String matching
rapidfuzz==3.14.3

# Cloud logging and analytics (optional - graceful fallback if not configured)

# Required for country bounds bbox intersection (viewport geometry loading):
shapely==2.1.2
# Required for WGS84 geodesic areas in compare_geographies.  Planar degree
# areas are not valid overlap percentages for global geometry.
pyproj==3.7.2

# Fairfax LST raster endpoint (reads GeoTIFF pixel data, pure-Python, no native libs):
tifffile==2026.3.3

# Legacy/Archive tools (not required for main app):
# geopandas>=0.14.0
# pyogrio>=0.7.0
